senses.gloss: m. (צְוַץ) chirper; מ׳ דתננא [smoke-chirper,] cricket in the chimney.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 102:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. CII, 4</cite> <he>כהדין מ׳ דת׳</he> (my days pass in smoke) like that cricket (ed. Bub. <he>מציצא דיקר</he>, read <he>דיקיד</he>, the cricket on the hearth, v. Bub. a. l. note 14).
